what: Plan uses the active branch and create-pr existing-PR fast path for the log PR
scenario_or_breakage: If /design runs nested under /implement or on a branch with an existing PR, the log publisher can push logs to the work PR and then squash-merge/delete that branch instead of creating a standalone branch-scoped log PR
suggested_fix: Create a dedicated log branch from the default branch, create the PR from that branch explicitly, merge/delete only that log branch, and add tests for existing active PR and nested SESSION_ENV_PATH cases

what: Plan passes --repo "$REPO" but does not bind REPO in /design
scenario_or_breakage: /design session setup currently uses --skip-repo-check, so REPO may be unset when the new rename/publish calls run, causing expansion failure or empty repo arguments
suggested_fix: Define the repo source in the plan, e.g. resolve via scripts/resolve-repo.sh or gh repo view before Step 5, and add a harness assertion for missing/invalid repo handling

what: Clarification completion path is not covered by the planned [PLANNED] rename and log flush
scenario_or_breakage: The clarify loop writes the plan block and exits successfully without necessarily passing through the normal Step 5b approval snippet, so a completed clarification design may leave no [PLANNED] title and no design log PR
suggested_fix: Factor a post-plan-write success routine and call it from both normal accept and clarify-response success paths; add a structural or integration test for the clarify path

what: Plan commits DESIGN_TMPDIR .meta and tool-envelope sidecars with only generic redaction
scenario_or_breakage: Committed run-log contracts strip CMD_JSON from .meta and top-level .result from output JSON before redaction; the new direct copier can publish raw argv/prompt envelopes or duplicated model output that existing log publishing intentionally trims
suggested_fix: Reuse the existing lib-redact sidecar trimmers or explicitly exclude those sidecars, fail closed on trim failure, and add tests for .meta CMD_JSON and *-output.txt.json .result sanitization

what: New test harness lacks a planned sibling contract document
scenario_or_breakage: The plan creates scripts/test-design-log-publish.sh but only creates scripts/design-log-publish.md; repo rules require every scripts/*.sh file to have a sibling .md, including harness stubs
suggested_fix: Add scripts/test-design-log-publish.md to the file list and Makefile/lint documentation updates
